description: This file defines API endpoints for managing deliveries in a delivery tracking system, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting deliveries, appending status events, ingesting location data, and exporting delivery data as CSV. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy ORM, and Pydantic for data validation and serialization.
